mutations.name: a phone gets the sessions table instead of cards
kills: the sessions list on a phone stacks each session into a card with its agent, tasks, PR and figures instead of the table

mutations.name: a ref link keeps only its text's width on a phone
kills: the sessions list on a phone gives the session, agent and task links a 44px tap target, and the short agent and task links 44px of width

mutations.name: Load more adds no cards for the older page
kills: the sessions list on a phone adds the older page as cards on Load more

mutations.name: a desktop gets session cards instead of the table
kills: the sessions list on a phone keeps the table on a desktop
